verdict.rationale: The platform has a documented API reached through the edison-client Python SDK, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every path. The llms.txt index and markdown docs are documentation formats, not API specifications, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
